name: ai-context-meter

frames.best_why: The breakdown panel is fully open over the footer, showing the segmented bar, every row and the button.

tagline: A token gauge in a chat footer opens into a stacked context breakdown.
summary: A slim prompt-footer bar shows how full the model's context window is, as a small ring and a percentage beside the model name. Clicking it opens a panel that breaks the used tokens down by source and offers to compact the conversation.
appearance: At rest a dark rounded footer bar holds a model name on the left and a tiny circular gauge with a percentage on the right. Open, a dark rounded panel floats above: a Context heading with a token total, a thin stacked colour bar ticked at the compact point, rows of swatches with token counts, and a Compact now button.
behaviour: The ring fills and the number rolls as tokens arrive, and the percentage shifts to amber then red near the threshold. Clicking the percentage opens the breakdown above the bar; hovering a bar segment dims the others. Escape or an outside click closes it.
demo_content: Three chat bubbles about refactoring a CSV exporter, above an "Atlas Pro" footer at 58%.
search_phrases: context window usage meter for chat
token count gauge in prompt bar
how full is the context window
llm usage ring next to model name
use_when: An AI chat composer needs to show how much context is left and let people inspect or shrink it.
avoid_when: The panel is a fixed 288px wide and opens upward, so it needs room above the composer on short screens.
customise: Pass segments with labels, token counts and colour classes, plus limit, compactAt, model name, defaultOpen and onCompact. Custom segments without a colour fall back to a fixed grey ramp.
weight_why: A few tweened numbers and one small SVG ring; the demo's growth timer pauses offscreen.

a11y.note: The trigger is labelled with its percentage and opens as a button; Escape returns focus. Hover-only row highlighting has no keyboard equivalent.

polish_why: Tidy footer and legible breakdown; the panel covers chat text and the smallest labels are faint.
title: AI Context Meter
